scripts.asbuild:debug: asc assembly/index.ts --target debug --use ScreenChar=assembly/host/ScreenChar --use KeyInChar=assembly/host/KeyInChar --use OutStr=assembly/host/OutStr
scripts.asbuild:release: asc assembly/index.ts --target release --use ScreenChar=assembly/host/ScreenChar --use KeyInChar=assembly/host/KeyInChar --use OutStr=assembly/host/OutStr
scripts.asbuild:wasi: asc assembly/wasi.ts --target wasi --use ScreenChar=assembly/wasiHost/ScreenChar --use KeyInChar=assembly/wasiHost/KeyInChar --use OutStr=assembly/wasiHost/OutStr
